description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy related to leave entitlement consumption, including handling scenarios with no entitlements, partial entitlement usage, and exact matches. It uses mock objects to simulate dependencies and contains multiple test cases for different leave entitlement scenarios.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing FIFO entitlement consumption logic within the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy and populating test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeNoEntitlements
methods.description: Tests handling leave creation when there are no entitlements for the employee and leave type, both with $allowNoEntitlements set to false and true.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeApply
methods.description: Tests leave handling when there's a single entitlement that is before the leave date range; verifies that no changes occur when $allowNoEntitlements is false.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeAssign
methods.description: Checks leave handling with an entitlement that applies before the leave date; expects a current entitlement change when $allowNoEntitlements is true.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterApply
methods.description: Checks behavior when entitlement is after the leave date; expects no change when $allowNoEntitlements is false.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterAssign
methods.description: Verifies entitlement consumption after leave assignment, expecting a change in entitlement tracking.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientApply
methods.description: Tests the scenario where an entitlement is not sufficient to cover the leave; expects no change when $allowNoEntitlements is false.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientAssign
methods.description: A skipped or disabled test meant to verify behavior when entitlement is insufficient to cover leave days, involving detailed array-based leave data.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExactAmount
methods.description: A skipped or disabled test for checking behavior when entitlement exactly matches leave days.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExtra
methods.description: A skipped or disabled test for verification when entitlement exceeds leave days.

methods.name: xtestGetLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: A skipped or disabled test for fetching leave date limits based on leave balance, mocking a leave period service.

methods.name: verifyEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the results match expected current and change entitlements.
